title: 2027 IMPRS EvolBio annual call for doctoral positions
institution: International Max Planck Research School for Evolutionary Biology (IMPRS EvolBio), Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Biology
about: Six doctoral projects in evolutionary biology offered through the IMPRS EvolBio annual call at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Biology in Plön. Project-specific applications are sent as one PDF by email until 10 January 2027.
requirements: Relevant master's or diploma, awarded before the doctorate starts
Separate project-specific application (single PDF) for each project
